title: Connect a TikTok creator
description: RecruitOps uses TikTok Login Kit with basic profile and direct-post permissions. Access and refresh tokens stay server-side and are encrypted before durable storage.
noAccounts: No TikTok creator is connected yet.
connectedNotice: TikTok authorization completed and the creator connection was refreshed.
deniedNotice: TikTok authorization was cancelled. No account was changed.
loadFailed: RecruitOps could not load TikTok accounts. Try refreshing.
startFailed: RecruitOps could not start TikTok authorization. Check server configuration and try again.
missingApiConfig: The frontend API connection is not configured.
ownerAdminRequired: Only OWNER and ADMIN accounts can manage TikTok connections.
